quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You approach an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn either right or left because the road is blocked ahead.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Once stopped, you may go when the way is clear.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill with a curb, turn your wheels sharply away from the curb. This prevents your vehicle from rolling into traffic if your brakes fail.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and be ready to stop. Look and listen for trains from both directions before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop safely away from the tracks and wait until the train passes.

questions.question: A Class D license allows you to operate a vehicle weighing up to how many pounds?
questions.explanation: A Class D license lets you drive a vehicle weighing up to 26,000 pounds. You cannot operate a taxi with only a Class D license.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used on a traffic signal.
It means the same as a red circular traffic light.
Drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones. Be extra careful for children and pedestrians when you see this sign.

questions.question: Is it legal to go faster than the speed limit when passing another vehicle?
questions.explanation: You must never exceed the speed limit, even when passing another vehicle.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks does your body process per hour?
questions.explanation: The average person's body processes about one drink per hour. However, how impaired you become depends on many factors: how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your body weight, food intake, and overall health.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign means a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, the speed limit in a residential area is:
questions.explanation: The default speed limit in a residential or business area is 25 mph. Follow any posted speed limit signs if they show a different speed.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be considered:

options.text: Safe to cross, as it is unlikely that a train will be coming.
Safe locations to park a car.
A place where it is required to stop.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains coming from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and directions from flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway slants toward the center. This shows that:

options.text: There is an intersection just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You will be required to turn left just ahead.

questions.explanation: A solid white line marks the edge of the road. If the edge line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: If a vehicle using high beams comes toward you, you should look toward ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: If a vehicle with high beams is coming toward you, look at the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: You must pull over to the edge of the road and allow an emergency vehicle to pass:

options.text: Only if it is following you.
Only if it is approaching you from the opposite direction.

questions.explanation: You must pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing without warning lights or gates, you should:

options.text: Cross the tracks immediately and as quickly as possible.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
Prepare to yield to any train at the crossing.
Speed up to beat any oncoming train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prepare to yield to any train at the crossing.
questions.explanation: Be ready to yield to any train before crossing the tracks, especially if there are no lights or gates. Do not cross until your entire vehicle can fit on the other side. Do not shift gears while crossing the tracks.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Require your vehicle to have a tune-up sooner than normal.
Set grass fires on country roads.

questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases and cools hot engine fumes. A leak allows these fumes to escape into your car. These fumes can make you drowsy while driving and can be dangerous.

questions.question: A single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Lanes are moving in opposite directions and drivers are not permitted to pass.
Lanes are moving in opposite directions and drivers are permitted to pass when it is safe to do so.
Lanes are moving in the same direction and drivers are not permitted to pass.
Lanes are moving in the same direction and drivers are permitted to pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lanes are moving in the same direction and drivers are permitted to pass when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A broken or dashed line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: A child under age 8 and under ____ inches tall must sit in an approved child safety seat while the vehicle is moving.
questions.explanation: Utah law requires children ages 4-7 who are shorter than 57 inches to use an approved child safety seat. Children should not use a seat belt alone until it fits them properly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. You must slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign, which in this case is 35 mph.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors and turn on your signal before changing lanes. Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: A child up to age ____ must sit in a rear-facing car seat while the vehicle is moving.
questions.explanation: Children should sit in a rear-facing car seat in the back seat until at least age 2 and weighing 30 pounds. If the car seat allows, a child can stay rear-facing longer.

questions.question: Signs for areas of public recreation are what color?
questions.explanation: Brown signs show cultural, historical, or public recreation areas. They help you find interesting places when traveling in unfamiliar areas.
